baseline.implementation: existing complete cumulative 10,000-group snapshot after each input batch

candidate.implementation: existing compact retract/upsert changes after each input batch

execution.driver: grouped_sum_state_benchmark --paired-changelog with one sealed release binary and the same stock/sparse Arrow fixtures
execution.comparison: interleaved AB/BA with maintained paired statistics
execution.timing_scope: fresh native graph plan, source/operator/sink execution, retained outputs and cleanup; fixture preload and subsequent reconstruction oracle are outside the primary timer and inside the total budget

execution.retention_rule: recommend changelog only for scenarios with actual measured benefit; do not change the snapshot default from this focused result
